answer: The cheapest Sybil gate is a deposit bonded to a detection graph. Each identity posts a stake, and escrow records its funding and payout wallets, so one pass links accounts sharing a funder. When a clone is proven fake, every linked deposit is forfeited, so a farm of N identities loses all N stakes at the first split. An attacker fanning stakes across fresh wallets still pays each and must survive a long voyage through low-reputation limits before earning, while every clone must look genuine for weeks, a tundra for cheap automation. Honest agents recover the stake after one dawn of work.
